Gideon, I posted the draft in this channel as a thread reply to your message. It uses the times from #inc-vtg-hartford:

- **First report:** 10:42 AM, when the gate kiosks went offline and both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- **Kiosk 1 back:** 11:03 AM, when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch confirmed it.
- **Both lanes confirmed working:** 11:07 AM.

The incident record is dated August 3, 2026, not October 14, so I used August 3. If you meant a different incident, tell me and I'll redo the draft. The draft also notes that Mateo's account still can't see the status page (tracked in INC-4821).
